Get started with the business apps

Five first steps. Each is ticked as soon as it is done, in whichever app you do it. Everything stays in this browser.

    Company profile

    These details appear on your invoices and orders. The default currency is the ledger’s base currency and cannot change once entries are posted.

    Products are kept in Slop Inventory, the product catalogue. They are not copied here.

    Numbers are gapless. Changing the prefix or digits affects new numbers only. The next number can only move forward.

    Tax rateProducts

    No products yet. Tax rates appear here once products carry one.

    Each product keeps its own tax rate. Change it in Slop Inventory, where products are kept.

    Records

    CollectionRecordsDeleted

    Full backup

    A backup holds every record, deleted ones included, in one file.

    Everything in one file

    Every app in the suite in one .slop-backup.json file: Slop Data, Slop Drive, Gallery, Music playlists, templates and profile settings. Secrets and caches are never in it.

    Restore

    The whole file is checked first. A bad file changes nothing. A good one replaces every record here.

    Reset

    Erases every record in this browser. A full backup downloads first, and you type RESET to confirm.
